vb_textbox.text: The aim of it is to get as many mushrooms as possible, I didn't have a consistent pattern throughout but i did realise that certain colours decrease mushrooms so change colours often for more mushrooms. x1 and x5 also changes colours nothing is the same throughout, remember the colour you selected and go for a different colour after...Dont go for the same colour on repeat because you'll get reduced amount of mushrooms..Just make sure to change tactics throughout, no forest is higher then the other either.Remember the aim is to get more mushrooms.
